## Linked issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Chore / tooling / docs

## Definition of Done

<!-- Constitution: a task is done only when acceptance criteria are covered by
tests, CI passes, and docs are updated if behavior changed. -->

- [ ] Linked to an issue, spec, or requirement (above)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are covered by tests
- [ ] All tests pass locally (backend + frontend)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed (ADR added for a significant decision)

## Quality & compliance

- [ ] No new vulnerabilities or secrets introduced
- [ ] ESLint passes / TypeScript compiles with no errors
- [ ] New-code coverage ≥ 80% (or dev-only code excluded with justification)
- [ ] Accessibility considered for UI changes (keyboard + screen reader; WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] Privacy/consent respected — no raw answers, tokens, or access codes logged or exposed
